clauses.text: the Power page of Settings offers the three power profiles and the sleep switch (read only)

steps.do: Open Settings, Power. Set Sleep after idle to a short time, leave the machine idle, then press a key.
steps.expect: The machine sleeps and wakes with the session intact; the chosen profile is still shown.
steps.runner_did: Checked the page text first (when run through the runner)
